remarks: Very spacious and updated home in the Thayer Pond neighborhood down the street from the Lake Club and the New Canaan line. Versatile floor plan with very spacious rooms throughout. First floor with large family room with fireplace. Separate laundry room w/ washer dryer. First floor also boasts separate suite with living room, kitchenette, bedroom and bath. Suite has separate entrance so great in law, nanny or guest suite. Separate laundry room with washer and dryer. Upper floor with large living room, eat in kitchen and screened porch for outdoor dining. All new flooring throughout. Master bedroom with bath and two more bedrooms. Great room which can be used as playroom, large home office or 5th bedroom. Lovely home in excellent shape. Flexible lease term. Tenant pays for credit report.
